versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated version number in SKILL.md from 1.1 to 1.2.
- Minor edits to an example in SKILL.md to clarify escalation language regarding reportable breaches under HIPAA.
Relicense to Apache-2.0 (matches each skill's own frontmatter); publish previously-unlisted skills (document-finder, legal-page-discovery, part-2-notice-assessment, skill-router)

- Removed the skill-card.md file and inline skill card documentation.
- Simplified and updated the description of the skill.
- Streamlined and rephrased the SKILL.md instructions and structure for clarity.
- Expanded example responses, including a new escalation scenario.
- Clarified escalation and legal guardrails, and moved version/author/license out of the header.

- Initial release of the Compliance Q&A Assistant skill.
- Provides compliance-specific question answering with regulatory guardrails, source attribution, confidence scoring, and escalation triggers.
- Works standalone or with context retrieved via the Rote platform.
- Strict constraints: no invented content, no legal advice, and clear escalation procedures when documentation is insufficient.
- Structured output format with summary answer, detailed analysis, context gaps, and confidence indication.
